## Observation
Read-only, 2026-11-11 ~20:00 PST, account 896586841071 us-east-1: 4 CloudWatch alarms exist that no file in the repo defines (`git grep` for `cache-ratio-low` / `unit-cost-high` on origin/main d583578c4da returns nothing):
- `bedrock-cache-ratio-low-opus-4-8`, `bedrock-cache-ratio-low-sonnet-4-6` (state OK since 2026-09-12)
- `bedrock-unit-cost-high-opus-4-8` (OK since 2026-09-12), `bedrock-unit-cost-high-sonnet-4-6` (OK since 2026-10-01)
Each has actions enabled with 1 alarm action. They were created outside Terraform (drift). Production traffic moved to the 5.5 inference profiles with change 3340, so these alarms watch model ids that no longer receive calls: they can never fire, and nothing alarms on cache ratio or unit cost for the 5.5 models.

The Terraform-managed alarm `rebar-bedrock-invoke-client-errors` was moved to the 5.5 ids by a production apply on 2026-11-11 (~20:00 PST, plan 0/1/0, only the 6 ModelId values changed); this bug covers the 4 that Terraform does not manage.

## Approach
1. Read each live alarm's full definition (metric math / dimensions, thresholds, periods, evaluation, the alarm-action ARN) with `aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --profile frontier`.
2. Define equivalent alarms in Terraform under infra/terraform/ for the current model classes (opus-5-5, sonnet-5-5, and haiku-5-5 if the metric applies), keyed so a future model move is a one-line change, reusing the existing alarm-action target.
3. Land through Gerrit; apply via `scripts/terraform_prod.py plan`/`apply` from a worktree at origin/main; confirm the plan adds only these alarms.
4. Delete the 4 hand-made 4.x alarms after the Terraform ones exist (record the deletion).

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Terraform defines cache-ratio-low and unit-cost-high alarms for the 5.5 model ids, with the same intent (metric, threshold, period, action) as the hand-made ones; `make verify` passes.
- [x] [non-codebase] The production apply creates them and `describe-alarms` shows them in OK or INSUFFICIENT_DATA (not ERROR).
  provenance: environment=AWS 896586841071 us-east-1 CloudWatch; principal=frontier profile; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — describe-alarms after scripts/terraform_prod.py apply
- [x] [non-codebase] The 4 hand-made 4.x alarms are deleted and no longer listed.
  provenance: environment=AWS 896586841071 us-east-1 CloudWatch; principal=frontier profile; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — describe-alarms --alarm-name-prefix bedrock-
